 Diwali Gift: Centre Announces 3% DA Hike for Central Government Employees and Pensioners, Benefiting Over 1 Crore People
 by 
 Ananya Pattnaik 
 October 28, 2026 
 in 
 National , Trending Now 
 Reading Time: 1 min read
 0 
 0 
 0 
 29 
 VIEWS 
 In a major pre-Diwali announcement, the central government has approved a 3% hike in Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR) for central government employees and pensioners, effective from July 1, 2026.
 ​Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the decision on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, noting that the revision will benefit approximately 1.16 crore individuals across the country.
 ​Revised Rates and Financial Impact
 ​With this 3% increase, the DA and DR rates will rise from the existing 60% to 63% of the basic pay or pension.
 ​The revision is structured across various pay commissions as follows:
 ​7th Central Pay Commission: DA/DR increased by 3% to reach 63%.
 ​6th Central Pay Commission: DA increased by 7 percentage points, moving from 262% to 269% of the basic pay.
 ​5th Central Pay Commission: DA increased by 14 percentage points, moving from 483% to 497% of the basic pay.
 ​The cumulative annual financial implication of this hike for the national exchequer is estimated at ₹10,016 crore. The upward adjustment is designed to provide financial relief against inflation to roughly 48 lakh central government employees and 68 lakh pensioners.
 ​Additional Major Cabinet Decisions
 ​Alongside the DA hike, the Union Cabinet cleared several key infrastructure and welfare initiatives:
 ​PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana: Allocation of ₹7,395 crore approved.
 ​Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme: A ₹10,000 crore scheme aimed at boosting domestic container production.
 ​Khelo India Sports Goods and Manufacturing Scheme: An outlay of ₹1,856 crore to strengthen sports manufacturing ecosystems.
